---
title: "Settings & Configuration"
---

Different projects have different test runners, different lint allowlists, different VCS conventions. You want a single typed configuration object available in every hook handler, with sensible defaults and `HOOKS_*` environment-variable overrides.

<!-- gd-embed: settings_config.py -->

**What to learn.** Subclass `HooksSettings`, a `pydantic_settings.BaseSettings`, to declare your project's knobs. Defaults live on the class, and the environment overrides them through the pydantic-settings machinery. This `enforce_test_command` handler fires on `Event.PreToolUse` and reads the resolved settings as `evt.ctx.c`, also exposed as `evt.ctx.conf` and `evt.ctx.settings`, so each handler gets typed configuration without a global import or a module-level config singleton. See also [Configuration](../guide/configuration.qmd) for how settings resolve across the environment and project files.
